question: are the extra restored parameters explainable as training-only in the PUBLIC source?
method: exhaustive text search of the pinned PAIR checkout for each extra name, plus reading the public loss/training call sites

results.transformer_c: 0 occurrences anywhere in the PAIR checkout (models, loss, train entrypoints)
results.local_weight_dis: present (model.py:207, used at :249-250) -> correctly exercised by public forward

findings: heads=4 and layers=2 are geometries the public code DOES construct (transformer_b) -- so '4 heads' is not by itself impossible for this codebase
but public transformer_a is declared 1 layer x 8 heads while the restored object carries 2 x 4, so the two cannot be the same layer stack
none of transformer_c/d/weight_chanelImg*/cross_t2i is referenced by public forward, loss, or any training call site in the checkout
therefore 'training-only' is NOT supported by the public source: those modules have no consumer there at all
not_claimed: that the restored 2x4 geometry is incompatible in principle
that the 5.20% dead parameter fraction was actually trained or actually excluded by the authors
conclusion: the public checkout does not define a complete consumer for this checkpoint's module set; full original-source equivalence remains unresolved. This supports 'exploratory mapping', not 'impossible'.
